More about Quippy
Edit
Quippy is a San Francisco daily practice app that helps people build social skills through short, realistic conversation drills.
Founded in 2026 by Jonathan Li (previously Head of Product at a16z-backed Luvu, scaling roughly $0 to $1.5M ARR in four months; earlier APM at Duolingo contributing to features such as Video Call with Lily and a monolingual English course) and part of Y Combinator's Fall 2026 batch, Quippy runs scenarios such as pushing back on a boss or talking
through a first date, then gives line-by-line feedback on what landed and what backfired. The curriculum adapts to each user's patterns and weak spots rather than acting as an open-ended chatbot, and the company stresses privacy as a practice tool rather than a social network. Sources: Y Combinator; quippyapp.com.
